name: Nebula‑Weave Tapestry Hall
description: An immense hall draped with tapestries woven from actual nebula clouds, shifting colors as viewers move.
prompt: Grand hall with towering walls covered in massive tapestries that appear to be living nebulae — swirling gases in purples, blues, pinks, golds. The patterns subtly shift with perspective, giving a sense of depth. Marble floor reflects the cosmic fabrics. Dramatic lighting, ultra‑high resolution, immersive scale.
caption: Walk through the fabric of the cosmos 🌌🧵 #NebulaTapestry
